Our contact email address has changed to DEFAC-ManageDAO@modgovuk.onmicrosoft.com. Any other email address stated on any of our documents should not be used.

Qualification hand books for Defence Awarding Organisation courses.

The most recent specifications have been produced in HTML format to ensure they are fully accessible. To download and print a HTML attachment as PDF document you need to click ‘Control (Ctrl) and the letter P’ on your keyboard. Once prompted you can choose to save the web page as a PDF and save to your desktop.
